sum: Bluemount Holdings Limited, through its subsidiaries, provides consulting, advisory, and financial services in Hong Kong. It operates through Security Related Service and Asset Management, and Trading of Timepieces segments. The company offers securities dealing and brokerage, securities underwriting and placing, IPO subscription, and other financing services. It also engages in the trading of luxury branded timepieces. Bluemount Holdings Limited was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
